extracted.name: El Vermut sangria
extracted.description: Get the party started with sangria, the classic Spanish tipple. With red wine and sweet red vermouth, lemonade and fruit, it's a fabulous summer drink
ingredient_lines: 420g can peaches in syrup, cut into thin slices
200ml Vermut Arlini (or any sweet red vermouth)
extra lemon and orange slices, to garnish (optional)
instruction_lines: Put the banana, orange, pear, lemon and peaches in a large pitcher with the syrup from the can of peaches. Muddle for about 30 seconds with a wooden spoon.
Add the vermouth, briefly muddle, and pour in the red wine.
Add the ice and top up with the bitter lemon or lemonade, then stir to combine. Serve garnished with extra slices of lemon and orange, if you like.
